Panelz · the endless comic · biome FOUR of eight

The Sunken Marches

Flooded lowlands past the dead timber. Everything here is wet, patient, and was mostly something else first.

I The towns and the roads between them

4 towns and a boss lair, 0 roads between them. Each card is the town's own panels, in the order they are played. A road is a thing between two towns: a town names where it leads on to, and the toll on a road is the level the town at its far end asks of you.

II Who is out on those roads

10 opponents can be run into in The Sunken Marches, and one boss waits in the lair. Each one is shown as the panels it brings to a fight, left to right in the order a fight plays them.

Meeting the encounter opening, and whatever it says before anyone swings
Attacks the windup and each attack it can make
Hurt what it does when it is hit, and any status or phase it goes through

IV Legend · everything they can leave behind

Every item on this biome's drop tables, what it is worth, what it does while it is in the bag, and who parts with it.

Fenlight Lantern

195 gold · 1 kg
  • +3 Agility while carried

It burns marsh gas and burns it green. By it you can see where to put your feet, which is more than most lamps out here manage.

dropped by
Fenlight Sprite 75% Bog Widow 50%

Leech-Gut Salve

175 gold · 0.5 kg
  • +3 Strength while carried
  • +2 health after a won fight

It smells exactly as bad as it is made of. It puts the strength back into a torn arm, and closes a little of whatever the last fight opened.

dropped by
Sumpmaw 75% Peat Shambler 50% Black Water Hound 50%

Marsh Strider Boots

230 gold · 1.5 kg
  • +2 Strength while carried
  • +3 Agility while carried

Splayed and laced high, made for ground that does not want to hold you up. Long wear in them leaves the legs strong and the steps quick.

dropped by
Stiltshade 75% Black Water Hound 50% Reedwalker 25%

Reedwoven Shield

120 gold · 2 kg
  • Armour · takes 18% off a hit, never more than 7

Marsh reed bound in tight rings. Lighter than it looks and better than it sounds.

dropped by
Reedwalker 75% Stiltshade 25% The Drowned Matron 25%

Ferryman's Obols

245 gold · 0.2 kg
  • +2 Strength while carried
  • +3 Intelligence while carried

Two coins worn smooth, strung on a cord. Somebody was meant to be paid with these and never was. Wearing them steadies the nerves and sharpens the mind.

dropped by
Tollwraith 60% Bog Widow 50% Belltoll Siren 43% Fenlight Sprite 25% The Drowned Matron 25%

Drowned Man's Hook

175 gold · 2.5 kg
  • Weapon · Drag Down, 4–11 damage

A boat hook that has been in the water longer than whoever was holding it.

dropped by
The Drowned Matron 50% Tollwraith 40% Silt Grasper 40% Belltoll Siren 29%

Silt-Caked Mail

210 gold · 7 kg
  • Armour · takes 24% off a hit, never more than 11

Rings under a crust of dried river silt. Nobody has cleaned it and nobody needs to.

dropped by
Peat Shambler 50% Silt Grasper 40% Belltoll Siren 29%

Bog-Iron Blade

130 gold · 3 kg
  • Weapon · Peat Cut, 5–9 damage

Iron pulled out of the peat and beaten straight again. It is pitted all over and it holds an edge anyway.

dropped by
Sumpmaw 25% Silt Grasper 20%
